experiments.learning_objective: Observe how voltage and resistance affect current in a simple circuit.
experiments.output_behavior: Display calculated current in mA. Highlight unsafe values (> 100 mA) in red.
success_conditions: Learner observes inverse relationship between resistance and current
experiments.reset_behavior: Reset voltage to 5 V, resistance to 220 O.
experiments.explanation_of_results: Current is directly proportional to voltage and inversely proportional to resistance.
experiments.limitations_of_simulation: Ideal components. No temperature effects. No wire resistance.

experiments.learning_objective: Understand why a resistor is needed and how to size it for an LED.
experiments.output_behavior: Display LED current in mA. Flag values > 30 mA as unsafe (red). Show LED brightness indicator.
success_conditions: Learner identifies safe resistor value for given supply voltage
failure_conditions: LED current exceeds 30 mA (simulated damage warning)
experiments.reset_behavior: Reset to 5 V supply, 150 O resistor, 2.0 V LED.
experiments.explanation_of_results: The resistor limits current by dropping excess voltage. Without it, current is dangerously high.
experiments.limitations_of_simulation: Ideal LED with constant forward voltage. No temperature effects.

experiments.learning_objective: Observe how distance affects ultrasonic sensor readings.
experiments.output_behavior: Display measured distance and echo time. Flag out-of-range values.
success_conditions: Learner observes distance changes in real time
failure_conditions: Distance < 2 cm or > 400 cm (out of range)
experiments.explanation_of_results: The sensor measures round-trip time and converts to distance using speed of sound.
experiments.limitations_of_simulation: Ideal reflection. No noise, temperature effects, or angular limitations.

experiments.learning_objective: Teach a robot to avoid obstacles using sensor input and conditional logic.
experiments.output_behavior: Show robot position, heading, distance reading, current action, and event log. Highlight goal when reached.
experiments.reset_behavior: Reset robot to start position, clear log and path.
experiments.explanation_of_results: The robot uses sense-decide-act: read distance, compare to threshold, execute action.
experiments.limitations_of_simulation: Single sensor. No motor physics. Deterministic environment.

experiments.learning_objective: Simulate sensor data flowing from an ESP32 to a dashboard.
rules: IF temperature > fan_threshold THEN fan ON
IF temperature <= fan_threshold THEN fan OFF
experiments.output_behavior: Display sensor values, device states, and event log. Show connection status.
experiments.reset_behavior: Reset all sensors and devices to initial state.
experiments.explanation_of_results: IoT automation: sensor input ? controller logic ? actuator output.
experiments.limitations_of_simulation: No real network. Simulated sensor drift. No cloud integration.
